name: Seneca
q: To be everywhere is to be nowhere
Ignorance is the cause of fear
The way is long through precepts, short through examples
If you know not which port you sail to, no wind is favorable
Life is long, if you know how to use it
We suffer more often in imagination than in reality
It is hard because we do not dare
Learning how to live takes a whole life
There is no easy way from the earth to the stars
To a great soul, the whole world is his homeland
Fate leads the willing and drags the unwilling
